meta.name: commit
meta.description: Lets git sign commits and tags via the ssh-agent, and lets pre-commit build and reuse its hook envs. Composed onto a base profile with --extends. Grants the agent socket only — the private key stays denied by group:deny_credentials; the public key and allowed_signers are read-only grants in the base profile. No network grants: hook envs must already be cached, so first-time hook installs need to happen outside the sandbox. The treefmt cache lives in the nix profile — extend both when a hook shells out to nix fmt.
meta.author: murar8
